summary: Implemented TimeElapsedColumn, Task.finished_time with capture/clear logic in Progress.update/advance/reset and Task._reset, the progress.elapsed default style, Palette.__rich__, a CHANGELOG Unreleased entry, and tests (test_time_elapsed_column, updated test_columns expected output, new tests/test_palette.py). Tests were NOT executed (per instruction not to run repository code); the test_columns expected output was derived by hand by tracing clock reads, and a regex check confirmed bar widths (25 start-frame, 16 finished-frame) and cell counts. Two trailing-space trims during editing were found and fixed. Nothing committed. Also added a CHANGELOG line for Palette.__rich__ beyond the spec; easy to remove. Please run pytest tests/test_progress.py tests/test_palette.py to confirm.
